candidates.entry: long top 2 coins by 6-month (126-day) total return, short bottom 2 coins by same metric, rebalance monthly
candidates.exit: exit all positions at next monthly rebalance (30 calendar days), or earlier if any position hits -15% stop-loss
candidates.sizing: equal-weight long and short legs, each leg sized to 25% of portfolio; total gross exposure 100%
candidates.regime_filter: skip when average 30-day realized volatility across universe > 120% annualized (i.e., extreme panic) OR when BTC-USD 90-day return < -40% (deep bear regime)
candidates.rationale: Cross-sectional momentum is the strongest documented factor in crypto (1.8% monthly per Grobys 2020). Using only 5 liquid ETF proxies reduces slippage vs 50+ coin studies. Regime filter avoids crash periods where momentum reverses violently.

candidates.entry: long SOL-USD and ETH-USD when their 7-day average funding rate (approximated by 7-day return minus 7-day risk-free proxy) is in top 2 of universe; short BNB-USD and XRP-USD when their funding rate is in bottom 2
candidates.exit: exit after 7 calendar days, or if any position loses 10% from entry
candidates.sizing: equal-weight long/short pairs, each leg 25% of portfolio; total gross 100%
candidates.regime_filter: skip when BTC-USD 30-day return < -20% (contango tends to collapse in crashes) OR when average funding rate spread across universe < 0.02% daily (no carry opportunity)
candidates.rationale: Carry trade in crypto (Borri 2021) shows Sharpe 1.2-1.5 using futures funding rates. We approximate via spot return differentials as a proxy for perpetual swap funding. Weekly rebalance captures persistent yield differentials while limiting crash exposure.

candidates.entry: long BTC-USD when 30-day realized volatility < 80% annualized; position size inversely proportional to vol
candidates.exit: exit when 30-day realized volatility exceeds 120% annualized (vol spike) OR when position hits -25% trailing stop from peak
candidates.sizing: target 40% annualized volatility: position = 0.40 / (30-day realized vol annualized). Cap position at 100% of portfolio, floor at 10%
candidates.regime_filter: skip entirely when BTC-USD 90-day return < -50% (structural bear) OR when 30-day realized vol > 150% (unmanageable vol)
candidates.rationale: Volatility targeting on Bitcoin (Baur 2020) improved Sharpe from 0.4 to 0.9 and halved max drawdown. Our more aggressive vol target (40% vs paper's 30%) aims for higher returns while maintaining risk control. Single-symbol strategy avoids cross-asset noise.

candidates.entry: long ETH-USD and short BTC-USD when the spread (ETH/BTC ratio) is 2 standard deviations below its 60-day rolling mean; reverse positions when spread is 2 std above mean
candidates.exit: exit when spread reverts to within 0.5 std of the mean, or after 20 trading days, or if either leg moves 15% against the position
candidates.sizing: dollar-neutral: long ETH and short BTC with equal notional value, each leg sized to 50% of portfolio
candidates.regime_filter: skip when 30-day correlation between BTC and ETH < 0.5 (cointegration likely broken) OR when BTC-USD 30-day return < -25% (systemic stress breaks pair relationships)
candidates.rationale: Pairs trading on BTC-ETH (Leung 2019) yielded Sharpe 1.0-1.3. This is the most liquid and cointegrated crypto pair. Mean reversion in the ratio is well-documented. Market-neutral structure limits drawdowns. Regime filter avoids breakdown during crypto-wide crashes.

candidates.entry: long top 2 coins with highest gradient boosting prediction for next-day return (using features: 5-day momentum, 20-day volatility, 20-day volume change, BTC dominance trend); short bottom 2 coins
candidates.exit: exit after 1 trading day (daily rebalance), or if any position hits -8% stop-loss intraday
candidates.sizing: equal-weight long/short, each leg 25% of portfolio; total gross 100%
candidates.regime_filter: skip when model confidence (average predicted probability across top/bottom picks) < 0.55 OR when BTC-USD 7-day return > 30% (euphoria distorts signals)
candidates.rationale: ML-based crypto trading (Chen 2022) achieved 58% accuracy and Sharpe 1.1. Daily rebalance generates high trade count (n>100/year) ensuring statistical significance. Using only liquid coins reduces implementation shortfall vs the original study's broader universe.

candidates.entry: long BTC-USD on first trading day of each month, hold for 5 trading days, then exit
candidates.exit: exit after exactly 5 trading days regardless of price
candidates.regime_filter: none (deliberately naive to test if any calendar effect exists)
candidates.rationale: DIAGNOSTIC: If no edge exists in crypto, this naive calendar strategy should fail all Tier-2 floors. It tests whether simple timing patterns (first-of-month effect) survive in crypto. Expected failure confirms edge has decayed or never existed for retail-accessible instruments.

notes_to_p3: Focus backtesting on 2020-2025 period. For momentum and carry strategies, pay attention to rebalance timing (use close prices). The vol-target BTC strategy is sensitive to the vol estimation window - test with 20-day and 30-day windows. The pairs strategy requires checking cointegration stability over time. The ML strategy needs a simple gradient boosting model trained on expanding window (first 2 years for training). The diagnostic strategy is deliberately naive to test for edge absence. All strategies use only yfinance daily bars for the 5 allowed tickers. Transaction costs: assume 10 bps per trade for realistic results. Report if any strategy fails to achieve n>=100 trades (especially the vol-target and diagnostic ones).
